title: Add JSON output for state verification
summary: Add stable machine-readable output for `covenant verify --json` so autonomous supervisors can evaluate memory, audit, capability, and receipt drift without parsing human text.
expectedFailureModes: Automation relies on human verifier text and breaks when labels or glyphs change.
`--json` suppresses the existing non-zero exit behavior when drift is present.
Live coverage does not exercise the public verifier CLI contract across a real daemon socket.
nextAction: Continue with the next autonomy backlog item.
